I could not edit the repository to resolve this issue: my assigned role for this run is fault localization only, with project source and tests left untouched.

The likely change sites are:

- [model/album.go](/app/model/album.go:41) and [scanner/refresher.go](/app/scanner/refresher.go:97): albums store image paths, but not their media directories. [MediaFiles.Dirs](/app/model/mediafile.go:87) already computes unique directories; the scanner currently uses them only to collect images.
- [core/artwork/reader_artist.go](/app/core/artwork/reader_artist.go:23): the artist reader gathers album image lists but computes no artist base folder. Its lookup starts with those lists, then tries the URL and placeholder.
- [core/artwork/sources.go](/app/core/artwork/sources.go:22): the shared lookup loop traces each attempt without its duration.

A fix should make album media directories available to the artist reader, derive a base folder, try `artist.*` there first, preserve the existing fallbacks, and time every lookup attempt. The intended rule for choosing a base folder when an artist’s albums span multiple directory trees is unclear from the code and issue text.

Implemented local artist image lookup. Albums now store their unique media directories, and the artist reader uses them to check the computed artist folder for `artist.*` before trying album images, URLs, and the placeholder. Each artwork source attempt now logs its duration. The database migration triggers a full rescan to populate the new directory data.

Added focused tests. `go test ./model ./core/artwork ./scanner ./persistence ./db/migration` and `git diff --check` pass.

VERDICT: FIX

**Code defects**

- [reader_artist.go](/app/core/artwork/reader_artist.go:66) always searches the parent of an album’s media directory. If tracks are stored directly in `/music/Artist`, it misses `/music/Artist/artist.jpg`. Check the media directory as a candidate too.
- [reader_artist.go](/app/core/artwork/reader_artist.go:38) leaves the artist cache key unchanged when a parent-folder `artist.*` is added or replaced, so the cache can keep serving the old image. Include that file’s timestamp in invalidation.
- [reader_artist.go](/app/core/artwork/reader_artist.go:106) accepts files such as `artist.nfo` as artwork. Filter candidates with `model.IsImageFile` so valid images and fallbacks remain reachable.
